additions.label: maverick-v2 exactInputMultiHop
additions.description: Explicit token swap through typed pool swap calls; packed bytes encode only pool addresses/directions/amounts, not arbitrary calldata or permits.
warnings: Static exact-deployment source/ABI inventory only; not live runtime identity, funding, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or complete workflow assurance. Independent exact-function grants, pauses, canonical calldata/value controls and protocol checks remain mandatory.

Packed single-hop input is recipient(20 bytes), pool(20), tokenAIn(bool) and uint128 amounts; multihop paths encode pool address plus direction segments. These bytes are a fixed swap route/amount format, not arbitrary execution data, callback payloads or token permits. Calls invoke typed pool.swap; recursive exact-output callbacks verify factory.isFactoryPool(msg.sender). No external callback or opaque multicall capability is added.

All swap functions are payable and can spend native ETH using fixed WETH payment logic. Native msg.value, existing token allowances, recipient and router prefunding matter; avoid leaving balances. A zero exact-output recipient selects router custody. Protocol-selected callback payer is msg.sender; callers do not supply arbitrary callback bytes.

exactInputMultiHop/exactInputSinglePackedArgs enforce minimum output. exactOutputSingle/exactOutputMultiHop enforce maximum input; tick-limited forms may partially fill. exactOutputSingleMinimal has NO maximum input or output-minimum argument; financial risk does not turn this typed swap into arbitrary execution. outputSingleWithTickLimit has both maximum input and minimum output. No swap has an intrinsic caller deadline; price movement, tick limits, rounding and liquidity can lose value/revert. checkDeadline/checkSqrtPrice helpers do not become transaction capabilities.
